items.title: BCS SEPANG TRACK DAY 2026
items.text: Get ready for an exciting day of speed, performance, and motorsport action at Sepang International Circuit on 3rd December 2026! All track slots are officially sold out, and registration for track cars is now closed. FREE ENTRY FOR THE PUBLIC! Everyone is welcome to join us and enjoy the excitement of BCS Track Day. See you at Sepang!

items.title: BCS Automotive Solutions | Your Trusted Continental Car Retrofit Specialist
items.text: Established in 2020, BCS Automotive Solutions operates in Malaysia and Singapore, providing professional automotive coding, retrofitting, software upgrades, and performance solutions. We proudly serve individual car owners, automotive dealers, and established brands, including official BMW, Mini, Porsche, Toyota, and many more. With over 20,000 vehicles served worldwide, BCS continues to deliver innovative retrofit solutions and reliable remote support to customers across the globe. BCS Automotive Solutions. Driven by Innovation, Trusted Worldwide.
